proof.amplitude: sum_v |psi_v|=(Rmax/Mpsi)Q=A=R0*q0/m0, exactly on the full tuple state.
proof.rate_cap: Original displayed c_a=m_a exp(-beta Delta F/2) <= exp(beta B); no added rate multiplier.
proof.independent: For each signed partial root, sum_x pi_r(x)c_a(x)<=1. E_r(f_r)<=Lip(F)^2 H*4^(-r). Finite weighted diagonalization gives error<=Lip(F)*sqrt(T H)*2^(-r).
proof.variance_witness: W=p^(-1) sum_(b in P) Re U_b; bounded, gauge and anchor-automorphism invariant, Lip(W)<=2/p.
proof.variance: Original Gibbs Var(W)>=exp(-2 beta B)/(2p)>0 for all r. Uniform counting is a comparison measure, not a replacement state. Its variance is 1/p at K=2, 1/(2p) at K>=3; Fourier orthogonality, not adjacent-face independence.
proof.common_limit: NOT_CONSTRUCTED; direct sampled readouts are not CRT transported fixed cylinders.
